user.title: PVOutput system
user.description: Enter the API key and system ID from pvoutput.org (Settings). The status interval and donor status are read from your account.

error.invalid_auth: PVOutput refused the API key or system ID.

abort.already_configured: This PVOutput system is already set up.

init.title: PVOutput fields

add_field.title: Add field
add_field.description: Pick a sensor, or enter a constant value instead (for example battery size), and the PVOutput field it feeds. Only fields not yet used and available to your account type are listed.

field_details.title: {field}
field_details.description: Name the field as it is labelled in PVOutput. Passive fields are recorded in the history log but not sent; switch them to active later and use the reupload action to send their history.

edit_details.title: {field}
edit_details.description: Use either a sensor or a constant value.

remove_field.title: Remove fields
remove_field.description: Recorded history of removed fields stays in the log.

data.output_fallback: Send daily outputs for statuses too old to upload

data_description.donor_mode: Donor accounts can send extended (v7-v12) and battery fields, upload 90 days back and 100 statuses per request.
data_description.upload_interval: Should match the status interval of the system in PVOutput. The history log always records 5 minute values.
data_description.output_fallback: When statuses could not be sent in time (for example after a long outage), send that day's totals as a daily output instead.

error.entity_or_constant: Choose a sensor or enter a constant value, not both.
error.unit_mismatch: The sensor's unit does not fit this field.

abort.no_free_fields: All fields available to your account are already used.

options.energy_today: Energy since midnight (from an energy sensor)

options.auto: Statuses where allowed, daily outputs for older days

select_entry.message: Choose which PVOutput system to use.

end_before_start.message: The end must be after the start.

reupload.name: Reupload history
reupload.description: Sends recorded history again. Days inside PVOutput's status window (14 days, 90 for donors) are sent as statuses, older days as daily outputs.

config_entry_id.name: PVOutput system
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one system is set up.

end.name: End date
end.description: Last day to send. Defaults to today.

import_from_recorder.name: Import from recorder
import_from_recorder.description: Fills the history log from Home Assistant's recorded states, and from hourly long term statistics where states have been purged.

config_entry_id.name: PVOutput system
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one system is set up.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the period to import.

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period. Defaults to now.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace samples already in the log with values from recorded states.

upload.name: Upload
upload.description: Send the imported samples to PVOutput. Off keeps them in the log only.
